newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank liquidates small Minas Gerais bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank liquidates small Minas Gerais bank.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank liquidated private bank Banco Progresso, based in the state of Minas Gerais, and its leasing unit for financial difficulties, a Central Bank official said.

"We liquidated Banco Progresso and its leasing unit because of economic and financial problems including a failure to honor their credit operations," said Claudio Mauch, director of the Central Bank's rules and regulations division.
Mauch said the liquidation of Banco Progresso had nothing to do with the Central Bank's investigation into alleged fraud at other banks and brokerages.
